Subject: Post-demo: budget nomination + procurement/security next steps

Thanks again for the time this morning — great conversation and a clear use case around inpatient discharge summarization and clinician triage. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Recap (2 min)
- Pilot scope: 3 internal teams, 6-week pilot, up to 50k tokens/day typical load
- Success metrics: 85% reduction in note triage time, <200ms median latency for 512-token context

2) Asks from your side (priority order)
- Nominate the person who owns the budget/approval authority for this pilot (economic buyer)
- Introduce procurement contact for SOW and POC contract terms
- Share security/compliance contacts so we can start the questionnaire (SOC2 scope, data retention, encryption)

3) Next steps from Redwood (what we’ll send today)
- Updated mutual action plan (attached) with timeline and responsibilities
- Redacted security summary and sample SOW (attachments)
- Proposed demo follow-up: 30-min session next Wed to cover integration patterns and expected token profiles

If you can reply with the budget owner and procurement contact this week, we’ll pull together a short commercial proposal and a tailored security package for internal review.

Attachments: redwood-demo-slides.pdf, mutual-action-plan-stellarmed.xlsx

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
